page.overview:
What is Beetroot Soup?

Beetroot soup is an unstackable food item.

Beetroot soup can be eaten to restore hunger points and 7.2 saturation, the same as cooked chicken and mushroom stew. After eating, the empty bowl remains, similarly to mushroom stew and rabbit stew.
